units.title: Plan Emerald's checkpoints from boot to a new game
units.detail: Original Emerald (~/ROMs/gba, matches the pokeemerald decomp). Find where it diverges from mGBA first, and pick checkpoints from boot through the intro and title screen to a new game's first overworld frame: each a frame + input script (or a save state, once {unit:shared/savestate-load} lands). File one emerald/<name> unit per checkpoint (computed, probe just unit), the BIOS calls and features they need as units, and make {unit:emerald/title-gate} need the title-screen one.

record.evidence: Ours first differs from mGBA at frame 16: no flash chip, so AgbMain sets callback2 NULL (blank screen). Ten checkpoints in units/emerald-*.env (copyright 100 to truck 5400), mGBA hashes stable and eye-checked; filed one computed unit each, plus {unit:shared/flash-chip} and {unit:shared/cart-rtc}; no missing BIOS call on the path (MultiBoot is link-only). Title gate needs {unit:emerald/title}. just check passes, commit 56a9dc0.

notes.text: Our runtime freezes on Emerald from reset: white screen, pc looping at 0x080008c6 from frame 300 on. From mGBA's state at frame 300 (mgba-dump --save-state) ours draws the intro BG but no GAME FREAK text/logo, and stays frozen there too.

units.title: Memory wait states and prefetch in the cycle count
units.detail: Decision 11 counts every access as 1 cycle; Emerald then runs ~2x fast and skips mGBA's lag frames: LoadGameSave takes 7.5 frames here, 14 in mGBA (189-203); copyright fade-out lags in mGBA too, so Task_Scene1_Load starts at frame 190 here, 204 in mGBA. Add WAITCNT-driven waits (ROM N/S, SRAM, EWRAM 2) and the prefetch buffer as mGBA models it, to the interpreter and codegen alike (bus-counted data waits, per-region fetch cost), and update decision 11. Done when gbaa-interp --trace 0816cf18 lands within a frame of mGBA's 204 and the units that pass now still pass (re-verify their hashes with mGBA if any change).

record.evidence: gbaa-interp --trace 0816cf18 now hits frame 204 line 166, mGBA's 204 (was 190). WAITCNT fetch/data/DMA waits and mGBA's prefetch stall, interp and codegen alike; decision 11 updated. just unit passes, hashes unchanged: gba-cart1, jsmolka-arm, affine, bitmap-affine, mosaic-modes, windows-blend, emerald-copyright. just check passes after merging main.

units.title: Emerald's checkpoints as two routes: intro and new game
units.detail: The owner's one-check-per-route decision covers Emerald. units/emerald-*.toml are still one checkpoint each (converted from .env by {unit:shared/route-checks}). Make two routes: emerald-intro (copyright 100, gamefreak 500, bike 1600, legends 2400, rayquaza 3000, title 3800; no input) and emerald-newgame (main-menu 1000, birch-speech 2000, naming 3800, truck 5400; Start 300, A 900, A every 20 from 1100), keeping each hash and mgba_hash. Both routes pass with just unit; repoint each Emerald unit's check, or fold them into two route units as Rogue's and Imperium's were.

record.evidence: units/emerald-intro.toml (copyright 100, gamefreak 500, bike 1600, legends 2400, rayquaza 3000, title 3800) and units/emerald-newgame.toml (main-menu 1000, birch-speech 2000, naming 3800, truck 5400) replace the ten per-checkpoint files, hashes and mgba_hashes kept. just unit emerald-intro and just unit emerald-newgame both pass (mGBA, interpreter, recompiled = interpreted); just check passes. The eleven Emerald units' probes now run just unit <route> <checkpoint>.

notes.text: Repointed probes (just unit emerald-intro|emerald-newgame <checkpoint>) went to main before this branch merges; if an Emerald unit shows broken, it's that window: recheck after merge.
